previewVerdict: Accept the 0.75 framing trial for current square/resting views. Final moving-expression, room, controls and camera-boundary evidence remains separate.
composition: Desktop now presents all three square fronts, both benches, planter, gate and same parked bicycle together.
Phone landscape reveals both benches, gate and paths with a recognisable original baby at roughly19px idle head-box height.
Original upright/shallow presentation and relative bear/baby/building/furniture proportions remain.

Phone upper facade/metro sign can still crop at the clear lane; approaching the north edge should reveal the front. Keep0.66 foot focus for now because lower framing risks the startup hint/control zone.
limitations: At about19px phone idle head height, subtle expression detail is reduced. These six resting-idle views do not prove all nine source moods are easily readable.
No rooms or video reviewed in this preview.
No physical phone, Safari or thermal testing.
